`scripts/check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` on `origin/main` routes a live, undecided disposition to a **closed** card — and the two ledger rows **two lines below it** route the same keys somewhere else.

## Measured on `origin/main`

**Line 204** — the comment introducing the `onTabChange` rows:

> … objectui#9344's item ②, which lands in the zod arms and not in this file.

**Lines 205-206** — the rows themselves:

```js
['tabs::TabsSchema.onTabChange', 'objectui#7804'],
['detail::DetailSchema.onTabChange', 'objectui#7804'],
```

**objectui#9344 is closed.** `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9344` reads `state: closed`, `state_reason: completed`, `closed_at: 2026-09-13T12:55:04Z`. Its body's item 2 is real and scoped — *"Per key, after that. The objectui#6124 disposition for each `onTabChange` read is MEASURED, not assumed — `runtime-slot` where the value reaches the renderer, `retired` where the read is dead …"*.

⇒ **two adjacent lines in one file disagree about who owns this**, and the one a reader hits first points at a closed card.

## The other objectui#9344 mentions in that file are fine — this is not a sweep of the citation

Lines **191**, **194**, **199** and **621** all name objectui#9344 **historically** — what it measured, what it taught `handlerReadsIn` to do, what it ruled. Those are correct as history and ⛔ should not be touched. Only **:204** is *forward-routing*: it tells a future reader where the remaining decision lives.

Control for the reading: the same file names `onCardMove` (2 occurrences), so the census reaches the ledger region in the right spelling; the `onTabChange` rows are exactly the two above and no others.

## What this card is NOT claiming

⛔ It does **not** claim objectui#9344 was closed wrongly, and ⛔ it does not claim item 2's work was never done anywhere. Those need a reading this card did not take. What is measured is only that **the file's forward pointer names a closed card while its own rows name a different, open one**.

⭐ The disposition itself is live: `detail::DetailSchema.onTabChange` is still a ledger row rather than a declared member, i.e. an **exemption**, not a decision.

## Why it is worth a card

The same dead pointer was copied out of this file into PR objectui#9343 — into a test comment and into that PR's body — and survived two repair rounds there before a review caught it. ⇒ it is not an isolated typo; it is a **source** that other artifacts are copying from. Repairing it at the source stops the next copy.

⛔ A `pm:on-hold` or an acceptance note does not fit: this is on `main`, no open PR touches those lines, and the seat that found it (`domain:spec` @ objectui, driving objectui#9343 to merge) does not own `scripts/`.

## What a fix looks like

One line. Either route `:204` to objectui#7804 so it agrees with the rows below it, or — if item 2's work genuinely lives somewhere else — name that carrier. ⛔ Do not write that the disposition is decided; it is not. ⛔ Do not touch the four historical mentions.

⛔ Filed bare on purpose: no `domain:*`, no `priority:*`, no type. Triage owns all three.
